prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE coherent 2-by-2 concept comparison sheet for four small spacecraft primary-form blockouts for a hard-surface space fleet game. Neutral charcoal backdrop, soft studio light, clear surfaces, all four shown in matching front-left elevated 3/4 view, noses toward bottom left. No starfield, no flames, no extra spacecraft, no huge battleships. Legible labels only: top-left CANOPUS, top-right SAKER, bottom-left PHOBOS, bottom-right HUYGENS. Earth craft top row, cool gray armor and small muted blue accents; Mars bottom row dark gunmetal with restrained burnt orange structural panels. These are basic mesh modeling references, no bolts or excessive tiny greebles. Show meaningful angular forms, connected equipment with visible roots, two aft engines on each, visible cockpit, one central fixed forward railgun (one bore, two rails), actual defense turrets small. CANOPUS recon craft 30m: broad blunt wedge sensor nose with dark planar sensor apertures on sides, short cruciform wings with outboard sensor ears, five compact probe cartridges on a dorsal aft carrier, twin aft engine pods, two small rear defense turrets one dorsal one ventral, small single containment keel underneath. SAKER defense interceptor 30m: distinctive broad forward-swept arrow wings extending toward the nose, armored forward shoulders, two widely separated rear engine pods and swept twin fins attached on them, upper and lower rear defense turrets, small contained belly torpedo bay. PHOBOS assault craft 26m: low aggressive diamond delta body and steep tapered pointed prow, full delta shoulders blending into two engines, deep but narrow armored belly containment keel for five torpedoes with one front launch port, tall symmetrical rear fins, one upper rear defense turret, NO reconnaissance equipment. HUYGENS agile interceptor 26m: slender needle nose and narrow pressure hull, small forward canards plus separate narrow swept aft wings connecting outboard engines, low paired canted fins, one upper rear defense turret, two small side probe cartridges, small belly containment keel. These must have four easily distinguishable plan silhouettes while sharing an industrial design family. Machinery is securely mounted, no disconnected floating parts. Use practical spatial volumes that can be built from simple lofted meshes. Keep full silhouettes inside each quadrant.
